title: Ay Hurr Hato Jawan
body:
waqte aakhir hurr ke jo bete ne di sada
daude hussain hurr se bhi pehle basad buka
jis dum jawan laash uthane ko hurr badha
kaandhe pe rakh ke haath ye shabbir ne kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
ay hurr hato jawan ka laasha na uthao
hum leke laash aate hai tum qaime mein jao
ay hurr hato jawan ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
andher ye kya dasht mein tum karte ho bhai
kab kisne jawan bete ki mayyat hai uthayi
bas pyar karo bete ko seene se lagao
ay hurr hato jawan ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
dam tod gaya saamne nazron ke jawan laal
tere dil e malool ka hum ko pata hai haal
moo se na kaho dard e jigar laakh chupao
ay hurr hato jawan ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
hota hai jawan laal zaeefi ka sahara
is laal ke mar jaane ne hum sab ko hai maara
purse ke liye aate hai hum farsh bichao
ay hurr hato jawan ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai khoob jaanta hoo jigar chaak chaak hai
ab teri zindagani e dunya pe khaak hai
mat bain karo laashe pe mat khaak udao
ay hurr hato jawan ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
apna shareek e gham mujhe samjho ay pur malaal
nusrat ke liye aaya hai ye fatema ka laal
phir kya majaal bete ki tum laash uthao
ay hurr hato jawan ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
laasha jawan bete ka kaise uthaoge
mujhko khabar hai dayr talak jee na paoge
maqtal mein khade hoke na yun ashk bahao
ay hurr hato jawan ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal ka kuch hi dayr mein manzar badal gaya
ek baap phir jawan ke laashe pe hai khada
aur bebasi ye kehti rahi ashk bahao
ay hurr hato jawan ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
hurr ke jawan bete ko sheh ne uthaya tha
akbar ki laash kaun uthayega ay khuda
ay shaah e najaf sheh ki madad karne ko aao
ay hurr hato jawan ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ainee kaleja dekhne walon ka phat gaya
aamir zaeef baap ne laasha utha liya
kehta raha jo hurr se ke na laash uthao
ay hurr hato jawan ka...
author: Ainee Rizvi
